name: Bonsai Solutions
description:
Bonsai is the analytics workspace for marketplace and Amazon brands and agencies. This connector lets Claude read the same dashboards you already use in Bonsai — Vendor, Advertising, Rank & Price, Seller, FBA, Feedback, and catalog health — without a database password or a free choice of tenant.

Connect once with OAuth. Company users sign in to their Bonsai account; agencies sign in to Bonsai Agency, pick an allowed tenant, then query. Tools are read-only except switching the active agency tenant. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. Ask for a KPI summary first, then the product/SKU table if you need rows.

You need an active Bonsai account with the relevant marketplace and Amazon analytics modules enabled and data already in the workspace. Claude does not call Amazon SP-API directly and does not write Vendor, Ads, or Seller data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bonsai Solutions to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bonsai Solutions to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.bonsaisolutions.it/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bonsai Solutions MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bonsai Solutions lists 70 MCP tools, including amazon-ads-ad-groups-products-tool, amazon-ads-ad-groups-summary-tool, amazon-ads-ads-products-products-tool, amazon-ads-ads-products-summary-tool, amazon-ads-brand-store-asin-tool, amazon-ads-brand-store-insights-tool, amazon-ads-brand-store-quality-tool, amazon-ads-campaigns-products-tool, amazon-ads-campaigns-summary-tool, amazon-ads-category-benchmarks-breakdown-tool, amazon-ads-category-benchmarks-summary-tool, and amazon-ads-conversion-path-products-tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bonsai Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bonsai Solutions in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Bonsai Solutions MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bonsai Solutions requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bonsai Solutions is developed by Bonsai Solutions. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
